steps: Cut a clean square/rectangle around the damaged area.
Screw a wood or drywall-scrap backer behind the hole for support.
Cut a drywall patch to fit and screw it to the backer.
Apply joint compound and paper/mesh tape over the seams in thin layers.
Sand between coats, then prime and paint once fully smooth and dry.
